query: Run /retro for the last 7 days. There are commits in the repository, but none fall in that timeframe; the most recent commit is 10 days old.
expected_behavior: Reports that no commits exist in the requested timeframe and does not import older work into the seven-day metrics
Does not invent a Shipping Streak, Focus Score, or Test Ratio from an empty sample
Uses the documented recovery path to stop the quantitative retro and explains the limitation
May offer to rerun for a timeframe that includes available history
